patch_description: This version keeps direct traffic as the strongest link preference, while adding a restrained two-hop reward: for each positive-demand origin–destination pair, it selects up to two relatively low-pressure relay candidates and shares a capped reward between them. This avoids letting the many possible paths overwhelm direct-link value. Relay ranking discounts paths that use pressured nodes or already busy direct links. The sparse path couplings also keep the interaction graph smaller than an all-relays construction. A stronger degree penalty encourages feasible samples; degree penalties are still left to the evaluator.
